project_summary: Distributed World Simulator is developed through parallel domain programs under one canonical main-owned architecture and control ledger.

G.short_description: Procedural geomorphology derived from accepted G7 semantic fields and G3/G5/G6 surface, feature and hydrology truth.
G.purpose: Add deterministic valley, river-channel, bank, floodplain and erosion/deposition shaping without taking ownership of persistent Matter mutations, world identity, authority, persistence or material ontology.
G.expected_outcome: A replaceable, provenance-friendly geomorphology layer that produces stable surface deformation independent from SurfaceCellKey, LOD, camera and representation and can later feed geology/volume/detail stages.
G.progress_note: G7 Semantic Field Fabric is ACCEPTED after the aggregate Windows gate passed on tested head a75a60b6da739cc759e1fb40510a98942bce4cde: G7.0-G7.4 ACCEPTED, semantic identity/provenance/cross-cell/presentation separation PASS, world/core regression through NX4 PASS, RL3 representation streaming 37 assertions PASS, main_scene_cli_all 6 PASS / 0 FAIL, lifecycle STOPPED and working tree CLEAN. G8.0 now starts on feature/g8-geomorphology from accepted G7 metadata head d9a900c28dee3914bcaa4d6f6bde126aef56a77e. Initial contracts define a deterministic profile and five-component signed deformation sample; valley and river components may only lower the procedural surface. No SurfaceCellKey, LOD, authority, interest, Matter, material, persistence or network identity is introduced. Stable UID sidecars are tracked. G8.0 acceptance requires the focused contracts gate plus a fresh full world/core regression on the same checkout before G8.1 may start.
G.next_stage: Run RUN_G8_0_GEOMORPHOLOGY_CONTRACTS_TESTS.ps1 first. If green, preserve the exact checkout and run RUN_G8_0_FULL_ACCEPTANCE.ps1. Only a full PASS accepts G8.0 and unlocks G8.1 Valley Incision Baseline.

T.short_description: Construction runtime recovery, late-interest synchronization and replication-scale policy over accepted T1A.6 runtime networking.
T.purpose: Make canonical Construction runtime survive recovery/reconnect and replicate only relevant runtime state at scale while reusing existing persistence, authority and interest foundations instead of creating domain-private global infrastructure.
T.expected_outcome: Recovered runtime state preserves canonical revisions and effects, reconnect/late-interest clients converge from authoritative baselines, irrelevant constructs are not replicated, and scale behavior is bounded without changing permanent identity or authority ownership.
T.progress_note: T1A.7.4 Scale / Soak Lab is ACCEPTED on tested checkout c0213f5edc078481c5705508244e6e556cd1945e. The prescribed Windows sequence required the focused T1A.7.4 gate before full regression; the user then supplied a fresh full world/core PASS from that same checkout with RL3 representation-aware streaming 175 assertions, RL3 process streaming 37 assertions, main_scene_cli_all 6 PASS / 0 FAIL, lifecycle STOPPED, exit_code 0 and NX4 final marker. Windows focused assertion count was not restated and is not inferred from the separate Linux 2394-assertion preflight. T1A.7.5 is a test-orchestration-only composition candidate with no production runtime changes after T1A.7.4 acceptance. Its focused runner reruns the complete T1A.7.4 chain (therefore recovery, real M3 late-interest/reconnect, selective process routing and 10k scale) and then an in-memory recovered-truth -> interest/session -> selective planner -> replica re-entry/reconnect convergence scenario.
T.next_stage: Run RUN_T1A7_5_COMPOSITION_TESTS.ps1 on Windows double Godot. If green, preserve the exact checkout and run RUN_WORLD_REGRESSION_TESTS.ps1 without fetch/reset. A green pair accepts T1A.7 Runtime Recovery / Interest / Scale as a complete checkpoint. Then converge through PC0 with TS0.4 structural/representation ceiling evidence before T2.0.

TS.short_description: Production convergence of TS0.3 local dirty-section evidence into the real C22/C24 Construction proxy pipeline.
TS.purpose: Transfer the TS0.3-proven local dirty-section rebuild into the production C22/C24 Construction proxy pipeline without changing canonical Construction truth, authority or persistence ownership.
TS.expected_outcome: Unit-grid local mutations rebuild only dirty plus neighbor sections, reuse unchanged content-addressed artifacts, rebuild FAR shell from section artifacts, preserve C24 graphical correctness, and safely fall back for unsupported cases.
TS.progress_note: C22 production convergence is SOURCE_ACCEPTED. Exact-Windows focused validation passes C22 incremental 28 assertions, C22 graphical 35 and C24 contracts 81. After FIX2 added the new incremental test to explicit world-regression coverage, the full world/core suite passes through NX4 with main_scene_cli_all 6 PASS / 0 FAIL and clean STOPPED lifecycle. Main drift since the convergence base is control-plane-only; active T1A.7 has no C22 proxy runtime/contract overlap. MAIN_INTEGRATED remains false until the accepted branch is merged and post-merge PC0 is run. The post-integration roadmap is now fixed in docs/plans/TS_C22_TO_T2_SCALE_CONVERGENCE_RU.md.
TS.last_accepted_checkpoint: TS0.3 / C22 Production Incremental Convergence SOURCE_ACCEPTED
TS.next_stage: Merge feature/c22-incremental-local-rebuild into main, run post-merge Project Control and mark MAIN_INTEGRATED. CH.short_description: Character presentation line for skinned garment/equipment integration over stable controllable-entity gameplay identity.
CH.purpose: Improve visible player presentation and clothing/equipment composition without turning rig, mesh, garment or Skeleton identity into player canonical truth.
CH.expected_outcome: Replaceable avatar/garment presentation adapters compatible with network authority and Item equipment semantics.
CH.progress_note: CH6 presentation/crouch/shadow baseline is accepted; CH7-8 remains the declared character presentation frontier.
CH.next_stage: CH7-8 focused acceptance and later equipment/network composition

DOCTRINE.short_description: Design doctrine describing how a large simulated world produces discovery, capability, infrastructure, consequences and history.
DOCTRINE.purpose: Keep gameplay/world-building principles reusable and aligned with technical foundations without giving design documentation ownership of identity, authority, material or persistence systems.
DOCTRINE.expected_outcome: A durable design reference used to judge whether new simulation mechanics create interesting interconnected gameplay rather than isolated features.
DOCTRINE.progress_note: Doctrine remains an active design reference and must map new mechanics onto canonical queries, operations, transactions and persistent world consequences.
DOCTRINE.next_stage: Continue doctrine updates only when new gameplay/system evidence appears

NX.short_description: Realtime transport, prediction, interpolation and future authority/interest/persistence policy integration.
NX.purpose: Provide responsive server-authoritative multiplayer without allowing packet order or transport ownership to define gameplay truth.
NX.expected_outcome: Network foundations remain reusable while tuning/fix branches can be registered as active frontiers when network work becomes primary again.
NX.current_stage: Tracked; no single active NX frontier declared in PC0 generation 2
NX.progress_note: NX0-NX5 foundations are established; separate M7/FIX tuning lineage exists but is intentionally not guessed as the canonical frontier by PC0 until explicitly declared in main.
NX.next_stage: Declare the current network tuning frontier in main before the next network acceptance

MATTER.short_description: Authoritative mutable material/volume truth with durable same-body cross-region transactions and recovery.
MATTER.purpose: Provide persistent excavation/material mutation semantics for later Geo and Construction composition.
MATTER.expected_outcome: MW10 remains the accepted transaction baseline until GM/T3/T5 composition requires new declared work.
MATTER.progress_note: No active Matter frontier is declared in PC0 generation 2.
MATTER.next_stage: GM Geo-Matter integration / future composition gate

S1.short_description: Proposal-only distributed compute where workers receive projected immutable state and authority commits validated mutations.
S1.purpose: Scale simulation work without allowing workers to become authoritative world owners.
S1.expected_outcome: Reusable compute execution for future generation, AI and simulation workloads under explicit read/write contracts.
S1.progress_note: No active S1 frontier is declared in PC0 generation 2.
S1.next_stage: Register a new frontier only when a concrete workload requires it
